assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Convert the supplied EXISTING production sprite strip into an EIGHT-FRAME animation atlas. Do not redesign or add costumes. NEW LAYOUT: four equal columns and two equal rows, 3:2 landscape canvas ideally 1536x1024. Exactly ONE complete pose per cell, frame order left-to-right then next row. All cells same dimensions, same scale and foot baseline at 84% of each cell height. Every visible part stays within its cell, with at least 12% transparent side and top margins; no neighboring teeth, hands, marks or scraps crossing cell boundaries. Genuine transparent RGBA, no drawn checkerboard. No grid lines, labels, words, background, floor, cast shadow, glow, warning circles or UI. Flat cream/sage/charcoal/brick colors, one cel shadow, no realism or 3D. Top row preserves the existing four poses: frame0 neutral idle, frame1 stepping left/action-one, frame2 stepping right/compression, frame3 hurt-squash. Bottom row is frame4 action start, frame5 action completion, frame6 death/crumple start, frame7 final flattened/scrap pose. Keep the body envelope broadly consistent; make the movements genuinely different, not eight translated duplicates. Collapsed poses can be smaller but share the same baseline. SUBJECT: the squat gray worn eraser Scrap creature, red scuff on its top, little tired half-lidded eyes, blunt two-tooth mouth, short stub feet. Bottom frame4 twists its soft rubber body toward a bump, frame5 squishes sideways with a put-upon angry expression, frame6 folds/crushes downward with the face still readable, frame7 a flattened crumpled eraser-paper lump with tired eyes. No gore or extra body parts.
